text:
- A circular diagram illustrates five stages of a product's life cycle, connected by curved arrows.
- At the top of the circle, the first stage is labeled "DESIGN AND SOURCE", accompanied by a recycling icon, with the description: "Maximize the use of recycled content and responsibly source primary materials".
- Moving clockwise, the second stage is labeled "MAKE", accompanied by a solar panel and sun icon, with the description: "Uphold high standards of labor and human rights, health and safety, and minimizing our environmental impact".
- Continuing clockwise, the third stage is labeled "PACKAGE AND SHIP", accompanied by a globe icon, with the description: "Remove plastic from our packaging and minimize emissions from transportation".
- Continuing counterclockwise to the bottom, the fourth stage is labeled "USE", accompanied by a leaf-and-plug icon, with the description: "Minimize emissions from product use, enhance product longevity, and seek to avoid exposure to harmful chemicals".
- Completing the circle on the left, the fifth stage is labeled "RECOVER", accompanied by a recycling hand icon, with the description: "Reuse products through Apple Trade In and maximize material recovery at end of life".
